# Goban Studio v16.0.1

A fix for macOS. On a Mac, v16.0.0 could not read the app's own files
after start-up, so a language chosen in Settings stayed English, lessons,
problems and classics could not be opened, the openings explorer was
empty and the stone sound fell back to a plain one. Windows was not
affected. Everything v16.0.0 saved is kept; nothing has to be converted.

## Download and first launch

<!-- first-launch -->
| Platform | File | First launch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `GobanStudio-macOS-arm64.dmg` or `.zip` | See the package README. |
| macOS (Intel) | `GobanStudio-macOS-x64.dmg` or `.zip` | See the package README. |
| Windows (x64) | `GobanStudio-Windows-x64.zip` | See the package README. |
<!-- /first-launch -->

`SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of every file. v16 needs macOS 13 or
later. Your games, progress and settings are kept outside the app — in
`~/Library/Application Support/dev.hxddh.gobanstudio` on macOS and
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dev.hxddh.gobanstudio\Data` on Windows — so replacing the
app keeps them.

## Fixed

- **macOS: the app reads its own files again.** The Mac's web view hands
  the app its own files with no status code (0) but complete, and the app
  refused them. It now accepts them when they arrived whole. This brings
  back, on the Mac: changing the language in Settings, opening lessons,
  problems and classics, the openings explorer and the sampled stone
  sound.

## Under the hood

- **The packaged app's self-test** now reads every language's strings,
  every content part, the opening book and a sound as the app does, and
  changes the language as Settings does; a release cannot be built when
  any of them fails. It is what found this fault, on the first run.
- A UI check chooses each language in Settings and requires every place
  to follow at once and the choice to survive a reload.

## Known limits

Unchanged from v16.0.0:

- **Platform code has not been tried by hand.** The Metal and AVX2
  engines and their fallback, the speed they reach, a save surviving a
  power cut, and the macOS title bar following the app's appearance pass
  their tests and the packaged self-test on CI, but nobody has run them on
  a real Mac or PC. Settings → Engines → Measure speed is there to check
  the first two; please report what it shows.
- **Not checked by people.** The KataGo notes on the classics, the
  Chinese-opening lesson step, the move verdicts and the strings in
  Chinese, Korean and Japanese have not been reviewed by a strong player
  or native speakers.
- **One joseki step is not judged.** After the 3-4 point's low approach
  and the knight's move answer, the book lists only moves elsewhere.
- **The builds are not code-signed.** macOS and Windows warn on first
  launch; the README in each download says what to do.
- **There is no Windows installer.** The download is a zip.
- **No Traditional Chinese interface.** The problem bank tops out at
  about 5 kyu.
